title: Mughal River Forts in Bangladesh (1575–1688): An Archaeological Appraisal
note: Kamrun Nessa Khondker’s MPhil thesis combines fieldwork and critical reading of contemporary and modern texts on Mughal river defenses. Its chapters on Mir Jumla and Shaista Khan discuss frontier campaigns and the 1666 Chittagong campaign; its archaeological focus means it does not provide a general fiscal history.
whyItMatters: The thesis evaluates Mughal river defenses using archaeology and textual sources, and supplies a separately researched account of Mir Jumla’s frontier campaigns and Shaista Khan’s Chittagong campaign.
